The standard 52-card variable is distributed equally. Each player offers a 0–13 cheat; a successful zero bid earns 100 points, and a failed zero bid loses 100 points. Teams combine their non-zero bids: they obtain the 10 total per bid by adding a bag for each additional cheat; if they miss this, they lose 10 points per bid. Every ten bags accumulated deduct the 100 point. Players must observe suit leadership when possible. As long as a player has only match cards and has won any non-match cards, match cards cannot be led unless they are broken.
